name: Lucent Ward
description: Raise the soul ward as clear glass that a hostile push cannot find a hold on.

name: Back Glance
description: Angle the glass so that a soul strike is turned and sent back along its line.

name: Sheen Sense
description: Read the silver surface of the ward for ripples that betray a nearby hostile soul.

name: Polish Rest
description: Smooth the dulled mirror of the ward so that the strain of a long defence fades.

name: Mirror Throw
description: Catch a soul lash on the mirror and throw a measured part of it back at the sender.

name: Double Sheen
description: Lay a second bright layer over the first so that a heavy will spends itself between them.

name: Deep Breath
description: Draw one deep slow breath and let the soul go still enough to bear a hard push.

name: Sink Away
description: Let the mind sink under the surface of a hostile push so that it passes overhead.

name: Calm Survey
description: Read the calm in nearby minds and note the one that is straining against it.

name: Calm Lend
description: Lend a measure of deep calm to an ally so that fear loosens its hold on them.

name: Slow Mending
description: Soothe the strained soul of the self or an ally with a long unhurried breath.

name: Edge Drowning
description: Sink a hostile will so deep into the calm that it loses its edge and goes dull.

name: Pool Hold
description: Hold a wide pool of calm about the self that swallows every ripple thrown into it.

name: Anchor Cast
description: Cast the anchor of the mind down so that a hostile pull cannot drag it away.

name: Anchor Shift
description: Lift the anchor and set it a pace aside so that a seeking will grips only air.

name: Cable Feel
description: Feel along the anchor cable for any tug that shows a will pulling at the mind.

name: Cable Ease
description: Ease a frayed anchor cable until the ache of a long pull leaves the soul.

name: Double Anchor
description: Drop a second anchor beside the first so that a strong pull must break both.

name: Slip Anchor
description: Cut the held anchor loose and leap the soul to a fresh point just beyond a grasp.

name: Echo Layer
description: Lay down a first soul layer that rings dully when a blow strikes it.

name: Ring Away
description: Let the layer ring so that the force of a blow is carried off along the sound.

name: Ring Count
description: Count the rings that follow a blow to judge how hard the sender pushes.

name: Quiet Layer
description: Rebuild a cracked layer of the shell from the inside with slow patient attention.

name: Rolling Echo
description: Pass the shell's echo to an ally so that their mind rings against the same push.

name: Triple Shell
description: Stack three echoing shells so that each one absorbs part of a sustained soul assault.

name: Fading Peal
description: Let a blow ring down through the layers until its force fades to a murmur.

name: Iron Will
description: Set the will as iron against a forced order so that no word can bend it.

name: Order Slip
description: Let a commanding thought slide off the mind like water from a waxed cloth.

name: Tug Mark
description: Mark the exact direction from which a stronger will is pulling at the mind.

name: Grit Tend
description: Tend the strain left in the mind by a long tug of wills until it eases.

name: Hold Firm
description: Say the inner word that makes an ally stand fast against a forced order.

name: Spine Draw
description: Draw the will up the spine of the soul until it stands straight under pressure.

name: Command Break
description: Shatter the grip of a forced command by naming its intent aloud within the mind.

name: Will Mirror
description: Answer a pressing will with the same will turned back on the one who sent it.

name: Lattice Frame
description: Build a frame of fixed points about the soul so that no single push bends it.

name: Spread Load
description: Spread the force of a strike across the frame until each point bears only a little.

name: Node Check
description: Test each fixed point of the frame in turn to find one that is weak.

name: Node Repair
description: Rebuild a damaged point of the frame so that the whole holds once more.

name: Tie Down
description: Tie every point of the frame to the soul's core so that a violent wrench cannot tear it free.

name: Frame Shift
description: Move the whole frame a step to one side so that a heavy blow finds nothing there.

name: Clean Ward
description: Hold a ward scrubbed free of stray taint so that no foul force can seep in.

name: Taint Turn
description: Turn a tainted soul touch aside before it can settle on the surface of the mind.

name: Taint Smell
description: Catch the sour trace of foul soul force in the air and find where it lies.

name: Rinse Calm
description: Rinse the mind with calm until the dull ache of a soul bruise lifts away.

name: Fresh Mind
description: Clear the fog from an ally's thoughts so that they see the fight plainly again.

name: Taint Lift
description: Lift stray soul taint out of the mind of an ally or the self and disperse it.

name: Erosion Wash
description: Wash away the thin film of soul erosion before it eats into the ward of an ally or the self.
